title: 2005 AMC 10A Problem 12
statement: The figure shown is called a trefoil and is constructed by drawing circular sectors about sides of the congruent equilateral triangles. What is the area of a trefoil whose horizontal base has length \(2?\)

solutions.text:
Since the base \(2\) equals two radii, the radius is \(1.\) The trefoil is made of four equilateral triangles and four circular segments, which reassemble into four \(60^\circ\) sectors of a circle of radius \(1.\) Their total area is \(4 \cdot \dfrac{60}{360}\pi (1)^2 = \dfrac{2}{3}\pi.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The base of length \(2\) spans two radii, so each circular sector has radius \(1\)
Rearrange the four equilateral triangles and four circular segments into four \(60^\circ\) sectors of radius \(1\)
